name: sk-skeleton
purpose: Animated placeholder that represents the structure of content while it is loading.

do: Use grid to represent card-based content collections.
Use list to represent vertically arranged content items.
Use text-block to represent paragraphs or editorial text while loading.
Render multiple skeleton instances from the parent layout instead of expecting a component-level item count.
Match the skeleton structure to the content it replaces.
Use skeletons to preserve the layout and reduce layout shift.
dont: Do not show skeleton and loaded content simultaneously.
Do not use skeletons as a permanent visual element.
Do not use a skeleton when content loads instantly.
Do not animate more than 3 skeleton instances simultaneously.
